“I will never forget about her”: Macaulay Culkin remembers Catherine O’Hara at 2026 Emmys

On screen son Macaulay Culkin remembers Catherine O’Hara at 2026 Emmys. Read More.

Catherine O’Hara’s co-stars Macaulay Culkin, Dan Levy and Annie Murphy paid tribute to her at the 78th Primetime Emmy Awards. People reported that Culkin, who played her son in Home Alone, opened the tribute by recalling how often she was described as the forgetful mother.

“But I will never forget about her.”

Culkin went on to thank her for showing up, and said the cast were showing up for her in return.
